recommendation: Keep the source change and do not restore the old preferred GMDN binding in current core. If GMDN content is reintroduced into the Device Type value set later, do it through a new terminology/work-group decision with the appropriate value-set and copyright metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-7590 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking to require GMDN as the Device kind; the accepted resolution rejected a required binding but changed the historical DeviceKind binding to preferred GMDN and added Device notes about GMDN.
initial_application: Git commit 0aa0bd9898801029935c8ac861ffb12380ba7d2e preapplied #7590 by changing the historical DeviceKind binding from an RTM example to a preferred GMDN binding and updating the Device notes to identify GMDN as the example device-type source.
additional_context: FHIR-9635 later changed Device.type from preferred GMDN to a SNOMED CT example binding while keeping GMDN in notes. FHIR-12897 corrected the GMDN note link and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-53019 then removed GMDN concepts from ValueSet/device-type after expansion failures, and FHIR-51642 confirmed no THO canonical update was needed because GMDN had been removed. Device remains active in source/fhir.ini, so source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml is current build scope.
reconciliation: Removed the obsolete GMDN copyright extension from source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml on Device.type. The binding now remains an example DeviceType binding to ValueSet/device-type without GMDN-specific binding metadata; the Device notes GMDN link remains because later decisions preserve GMDN as an alternate coding source note.
source_changes: source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: removed the stale http://hl7.org/fhir/build/StructureDefinition/copyright extension with the GMDN trademark text from the Device.type binding.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive later Device issue that superseded the old preferred GMDN binding by moving Device.type to a SNOMED CT example binding while keeping GMDN in notes.
Corrected the historical GMDN note link; an existing AutoFHIR audit commit for this issue is already present on the combined branch.
Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 issue that removed GMDN concepts from ValueSet/device-type after expansion problems, supporting removal of stale GMDN binding metadata.
Resolved - No Change issue stating no GMDN canonical fix was needed because GMDN had been removed from the Device Type value set.
